newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRACHMA EASIER, DEPOS HOLD, SHORT FORWARDS FIRME.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRACHMA EASIER, DEPOS HOLD, SHORT FORWARDS FIRME.

text.p: Greek depos were trading narrowly in late dealings holding morning levels and forex forwards were firmer in short periods, bonds were unmoved and ecu/drachma was easier, traders said.
"Depos and forex forwards are slightly up in short tenors in thin, quiet trading," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Bonds are holding morning levels and the market is awaiting to hear more about new issues and auctions of government securities, traders said.
The mark was quoted at 158.72/82 from Tuesday's 158.830 fix, the dollar at 274.53/63 drachmas from 274.590 and the ecu at 309.60/70 from 309.750 drachmas.
"The drachma is slightly up against the ecu and the mark," said a forex trader. "The story of te day is the advance of the pound."
